behavior: No part of a toast has a tab stop while it has `aria-hidden`, as ACT rule 6cfa84 asks. A toast of high priority, its `Toast.Action` and its `Toast.Close` have no tab stop until the keyboard focus comes into the viewport. `Toast.Close` has no tab stop while the stack is collapsed. While a toast of high priority has no tab stop, the viewport has one. Tab to the viewport moves the focus to the first toast, and Shift+Tab to the viewport moves it to the last toast. A Tab after a press in the viewport gives the parts their tab stops before the focus moves. So Tab reaches each toast, and axe-core reports no part of a toast under the rule `aria-hidden-focus`. Base UI gives `aria-hidden` to the same elements and keeps their tab stops.
